meta.parties: H.M.Ukku Amma v. A.M. Dingiri Menika

rules.statement: Section 5(d) of the Kandyan Law Ordinance prevents a donor from revoking a gift if they have expressly renounced their right to revoke, even if the donee fails to provide promised assistance.
rules.supporting_quote: "Section 5 (d) of the Kandyan Law Ordinance provides that 'it shall not be lawful for a donor to cancel or revoke . . . any gift, the right to cancel or revoke which shall have been expressly renounced by the donor, either in the instrument affecting that gift, or in any subsequent instrument, by a declaration containing the words ' I renounce the right to revoke' or words of substantially the same meaning . . '."
rules.statute_citation_verbatim: Section 5 (d) of the Kandyan Law Ordinance (Cap.59)
